samples.evidence: with 11 men who use alcohol and other drugs and who attempted suicide. (from 003_abstract p0); por meio da entrevista fenomenológica com 11 homens usuários de álcool e outras drogas que tentaram suicídio. (from 004_resumo p0); Investigación cualitativa desarrollada en un Centro de Atención de Drogas y Alcohol Psicosocial en el estado de Rio Grande do Sul (RS), Brasil, en diciembre de 2011, a través de la entrevista fenomenológica con 11 hombres usuarios del alcohol y otras drogas, que intentaron suicidio. (from 005_resumen p0); A total of 11 (eleven) interviews were conducted with men who used alcohol and/or drugs, who had attempted suicide and who were undergoing treatment at the service in December 2011.
